events.whyItMatters: First time Apple has committed fab work to Intel Foundry. Signals Intel's foundry turnaround is landing real marquee customers, not just government deals.

phases.headline: Report: Apple in talks with Intel over custom chip manufacturing
Apple and Intel announce multi-year chip manufacturing partnership

events.whyItMatters: Largest buyback authorization in company history. Reads as management signalling the stock is undervalued at current levels despite the run-up.

phases.headline: Nvidia board approves $50B share repurchase program

events.whyItMatters: Would extend AMD's adaptive-computing push beyond the Xilinx deal. Still unconfirmed, so treat as speculative — included because it's already widely reported.

phases.headline: AMD reportedly exploring bid for Lattice Semiconductor

events.whyItMatters: Castlelake's fifth and finally-accepted bid would take one of Europe's biggest low-cost carriers private at £6.90/share (£5.5bn), ending EasyJet's run as a listed stock. The private-equity firm still has until Aug 3 to table a binding offer, so completion isn't assured — the stock trading below the offer price shows that skepticism.

phases.headline: EasyJet board backs £5.5bn ($7.3bn) take-private proposal from Castlelake

events.whyItMatters: ITV exits broadcasting: selling ITVX and its free-to-air channels to Comcast's Sky for up to £1.6bn leaves ITV a pure-play content producer (ITV Studios) and funds a ~£950m (25p/share) cash return to shareholders. Consolidates UK TV into a Sky-led streaming and advertising champion.

phases.headline: ITV agrees sale of Media & Entertainment arm to Sky for up to £1.6bn

events.whyItMatters: A 20-year lease worth ~$19bn in contracted revenue turns TeraWulf from a bitcoin miner into an AI-infrastructure landlord with two decades of visible revenue — a step-change versus its prior scale. A paired sale of its Abernathy JV stake to Fluidstack (~$450m) funds redeployment into wholly-owned AI capacity.

phases.headline: TeraWulf signs 20-year, ~$19bn AI data-center lease with Anthropic
